description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Hevanpola, Rideegama D/S Division,Kurunegala District (25/0135)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, and property registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, and title classifications, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
